name: OreSpawn (Destiny port)
description: OreSpawn 1.7.10-20.3 by TheyCallMeDanger, ported to Minecraft 26.3 Fabric. Needs the original OreSpawn 1.7.10-20.3 file (orespawn-1.7.10-20.3.zip) in the mods folder: this port contains none of OreSpawn's files and reads its textures, sounds, models and dungeons from that file.
